assetPipeline.commercialProofRule: Commercial-license assets require a redacted proof record under assets/arpg/intake/approved/ before manifest intake.
assetPipeline.generatorRule: Illustrated 2D is the primary game-art production path. GPT Image 2 and Seedance 2.0 are optional operator-approved tools only; generated runtime outputs require prompt records, rights review, normalization, and no forced paid dependency.

menuSurface.compactModeRule: Persistent HUD stays chip-first and playfield-dominant; text-heavy RPG systems live in drawers or modal-depth panels.

requiredPanels.label: Start / Continue
requiredPanels.coverage: continue, manual save, reset confirmation, tutorial recovery
requiredPanels.emptyState: No manual slot yet; continue from autosave and create a manual save.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Drawer entrance respects reduced motion; save actions have no autoplay animation.

requiredPanels.label: Character sheet
requiredPanels.coverage: race, class, subclass, origin, palette, stats, identity tags
requiredPanels.emptyState: Default Veyr Human Wardbreaker identity is shown until the player edits creation choices.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Palette and identity changes update instantly without camera motion.

requiredPanels.label: Inventory grid
requiredPanels.coverage: items, stack counts, consumables, quest items, icon provenance
requiredPanels.emptyState: Starter inventory and discovered loot are shown; empty categories collapse to compact rows.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Item rows use static icon feedback when reduced motion is active.

requiredPanels.label: Armory comparison
requiredPanels.coverage: gear slots, item quality, upgrade rank, salvage, craft comparison
requiredPanels.emptyState: Selected gear falls back to currently equipped starter gear for comparison.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Upgrade, craft, and salvage feedback avoids flashes in reduced motion.

requiredPanels.label: Skill tree
requiredPanels.coverage: active/passive unlocks, hotbar equip, prerequisites, cooldowns
requiredPanels.emptyState: Class starter skills stay visible even before optional nodes unlock.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Skill unlock state changes use text and chip updates instead of pulse motion.

requiredPanels.label: Quest journal
requiredPanels.coverage: main quest, city arcs, side arcs, faction flags
requiredPanels.emptyState: The active reliquary quest remains pinned until city arcs are accepted.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Quest transitions are summarized as static log rows.

requiredPanels.label: Codex
requiredPanels.coverage: enemy, lore, relic, city, boss discovery
requiredPanels.emptyState: Undiscovered lore is represented by compact locked rows, not empty panels.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Codex discovery relies on chips and text labels when motion is reduced.

requiredPanels.label: World map
requiredPanels.coverage: 12 cities, routes, travel events, unlock posture
requiredPanels.emptyState: Locked cities stay visible as route objectives until discovered.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Route selection avoids animated map sweeps in reduced motion.

requiredPanels.label: City map
requiredPanels.coverage: 48 sub-cities, local conflicts, vendors, champions, tutorial prompts
requiredPanels.emptyState: Sub-cities show compact locked, known, or selected states by city.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: District changes use static selection state only.

requiredPanels.label: Reputation
requiredPanels.emptyState: Neutral reputations remain listed so city consequences are visible early.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Reputation deltas are shown as text chips instead of animated counters.

requiredPanels.label: Companions
requiredPanels.coverage: recruitment, perk, loyalty quest, travel banter posture
requiredPanels.emptyState: Recruitable companions show locked, available, or traveling state.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Companion state changes avoid ambient pulse loops.

requiredPanels.label: Settings / controls
requiredPanels.coverage: size, reduced motion, command-room fallback, keyboard hints
requiredPanels.emptyState: Default controls remain visible even before customization exists.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Controls and room toggles never trigger nonessential motion.

requiredPanels.label: Credits
requiredPanels.coverage: license, author, source URL, visible credit, blocked real-pack state
requiredPanels.emptyState: Real asset preview stays blocked until approved packs are imported.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Asset provenance panels are static by default.

requiredPanels.label: Save recovery
requiredPanels.coverage: envelope export/import, corrupted JSON block, checkpoint restoration
requiredPanels.emptyState: Recovery starts from autosave until manual and checkpoint slots exist.
requiredPanels.reducedMotion: Import/export and reset confirmation are text-first safety states.

slotPolicies.cadence: after movement, combat, travel, quest, craft, companion, or settings changes
zone gate, boss gate, city unlock, and postgame trial entry

saveHardening.exportFormat: JSON envelope with active slot and normalized v3 save payload

fixtureSuites.target: Level 1-50 progression is monotonic and supports prologue, city, finale, and postgame pacing.
Normal enemies, elites, bosses, chests, vendors, crafting, and relic trials all have deterministic reward expectations.
Mini-boss, city boss, act boss, final boss, and world boss attempts have target duration ranges.
Boss attempts consume enough consumables to matter without forcing grind loops.
All eight class paths have at least one durable beginner build and one late-game build target.
Upgrade shards, relic dust, catalysts, salvage, and city currencies have anti-grind caps.
Drawers, combat input, first interaction, and playfield FPS have budgeted browser targets.
Every major city and sub-city arc receives a documented playtest checkpoint before MW6 closure.

closureRules: All MW6U-AA tracks are done or intentionally blocked with documented operator action.
The first viewport reads as a game and command input remains usable.
No unverified or franchise-derived assets are shipped.
Resources and handoff docs match the verified state.

fallbackProofMatrix.label: Static release gates
fallbackProofMatrix.acceptance: Content, assets, production, and release contracts validate without browser automation.

fallbackProofMatrix.label: Deterministic gameplay validators
fallbackProofMatrix.acceptance: Save migration, combat/item balance, city registry, quest tooling, and authoring helpers stay deterministic.

fallbackProofMatrix.label: Browser fallback route proof
fallbackProofMatrix.acceptance: When Windows Playwright spawn is blocked, HTTP/source proof plus in-app browser acceptance can close the tranche without treating worker EPERM as a product failure.

fallbackProofMatrix.label: Private lane isolation
fallbackProofMatrix.acceptance: Aether Reliquary remains private inside /hq and Homefront public positioning stays separate.
